name: World Map
_comment: The world-map hub (MapHub), drawn as the evil cat (EvilMeowmeow.prefab), design V156. honeycomb: odd rows sit half a tile right. # wall, G green wall = a level not disclosed yet, P start. Portals unlock in the WorldMap order (Store, Pick Character, Basic, Level 1, Level 2); every one after the Store is a green stone until its turn. The two eyes are hollow, their outlines run green, rock, gap, rock round from the tip, with a miner in each (compete: they shoot at the player and time slows while the player stands still); a hook costs 1 HP; at 0 HP the player revives at Pick Character with full HP, and every won level refills it. still_time_scale = how slow time gets while standing still. The miners hunt only the player (hunt_player) and guard 4 one-time small gold in the eyes' top corners ($200, enough for the cheapest Store item). hook_wall_grace 0: the eye miners' hooks stop at the first rock they touch.
